formats.format: <scope segment>/<first two hex chars of sha256>/<sha256 hex> (BlobScope::segment())
formats.why: the storage key of a blob in the content-addressed store; stored in v_blobs.storage_key and on disk

formats.format: ULID string (Str::ulid()) assigned when the DomainEvent is built; one value per occurrence (UNIQUE in activity and outbox, with endpoint in deliveries)
formats.why: the occurrence id that activity, outbox and webhook deliveries key on

formats.format: "<node id>.<collab epoch>.<state version>" (strong, quoted)
formats.why: validator of document content; If-Match on writes

formats.format: "<node id>.<sequence>.<first 16 hex of sha256 of the canonical representation>" (strong, quoted)
formats.why: validator of a node representation; If-Match on writes

formats.format: "<kind>.<id>.<version>" (strong, quoted): kind access (node id, v_nodes.access_version; the etag of grants.index), share (link id, v_node_shares.version), drive (drive id, v_drives.version), comment (comment id, v_node_comments.version), webhook-endpoint (endpoint id, v_webhook_endpoints.version); in the body as etag, as the ETag header of single-resource mutation answers without a secret
formats.why: D47 (CC2): validator of the aggregates with a version of their own; If-Match of grants.destroy, access.inheritance.*, shares.update/rotate/destroy, drives.archive/unarchive/destroy, and (kind comment, owner documents) comments.resolve/destroy, and (kind webhook-endpoint, owner webhooks) webhook-endpoints.update/deactivate/rotate-secret/destroy (412 stale_write)

formats.format: If-Match header: one or more strong entity tags; weak tags never match; absent -> 428 precondition_required, no match -> 412
formats.why: generic header parsing stays in the kernel (architecture#kernel)

formats.format: format 2: base64url(json{v:2,t,d,pt,pi,pr,g,e,a,i,n}) . base64url(HMAC-SHA256(cursor_subkey,json)); cursor_subkey = HMAC-SHA256(app.key exact bytes, lp(vaulter.changes.cursor.v2)); typed reader/tenant/drive/generation/epoch/position/issued_at/not_after binding; signed, not encrypted
formats.why: PLAN4-D20: reader-bound format 2 cursor; original issued_at and monotonically decreasing not_after

formats.format: X-Vaulter-Api-Version response header on every response
formats.why: kernel HTTP frame

formats.format: X-Request-Id: an accepted incoming id (also read from X-Correlation-Id) or a new ULID; echoed on every response
formats.why: kernel correlation id

formats.format: X-Vaulter-Collab-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-Vaulter-Collab-Signature (lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<raw body>" with the hub webhook secret); a replayed signature is refused
formats.why: the hub's call authentication (the collaboration package, D1)

formats.format: Tus 1.0.0 resumable uploads: Tus-Resumable, Tus-Version, Tus-Extension (creation,termination), Tus-Max-Size, Upload-Offset, Upload-Length, Upload-Metadata
formats.why: the upload protocol headers

formats.format: HS256 JWT: sub, sub_type (trusted host morph type), document_id, drive_id, tenant (exact nullable string), protocol, state_format, generation, schema_version, scope (read|write ceiling), permissions_version {drive, global}, room (<channel prefix>.<drive_id>.<document_id>.<generation>), iat, exp (min(iat + hub.token_ttl, grant.notAfter); now < exp + hub.clock_skew, actual skew 0..60 default30), jti
formats.why: the room token the hub relays and the backend verifies and renews

formats.format: JSON: id (event id), type, version (1), source (vaulter), time (UTC ms Z), tenant_id, drive_id, subject{type,id}, sequence, actor{type,id}, correlation_id, changes{seq}|null, data (object)
formats.why: the outbound event payload: the outbox envelope body every consumer receives, forwarded byte for byte by webhooks.fanout (D29)

formats.format: Standard Webhooks headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature (v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>), several secrets space separated during rotation
formats.why: outbound delivery signing

formats.format: <module>.<resource>.<verb>, dotted lowercase segments, at most 64 bytes (OperationSpec::NAME_PATTERN); one name per mutating operation: documents.comments.add, documents.comments.delete, documents.comments.resolve, documents.documents.create, documents.documents.restore, documents.documents.set_retention, documents.documents.snapshot, documents.documents.update, documents.documents.update_content, drive.access.grant, drive.access.invalidate, drive.access.restore_inheritance, drive.access.restrict_inheritance, drive.access.revoke, drive.files.add_revision, drive.files.delete_revision, drive.files.restore_revision, drive.files.set_revision_retention, drive.files.upload, drive.folders.create, drive.nodes.copy, drive.nodes.move, drive.nodes.rename, drive.nodes.set_properties, drive.nodes.star, drive.nodes.trash, drive.nodes.unstar, drive.shares.create, drive.shares.revoke, drive.shares.rotate, drive.shares.update, drive.trash.empty, drive.trash.purge, drive.trash.restore, drive.uploads.abort, drive.uploads.complete, drive.uploads.initiate, webhooks.endpoints.deactivate, webhooks.endpoints.delete, webhooks.endpoints.redeliver, webhooks.endpoints.register, webhooks.endpoints.rotate_secret, webhooks.endpoints.update
formats.why: the operation identity of the pipeline: telemetry label and part of the idempotency scope tuple (D25)

formats.format: Idempotency-Key request header: one Structured Field String ("…", \" and \\ escapes) or one token of visible ASCII without commas; 1-255 bytes, never trimmed or case-folded; Idempotent-Replayed: true on a replayed response
formats.why: D25: the HTTP spelling of the idempotency key on the routes of idempotent operations

formats.format: lowercase hex SHA-256 over tenant_kind, tenant_id, scope_kind, scope_id, actor_kind, actor_id, operation, key, each as <byte length>:<bytes> and a null as ~; a user actor_id is <byte length of type>:<type>|<id> (sha256:<hex> of it beyond 191 bytes), a system actor_id null; request hash = hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON fingerprint (keys sorted, unescaped slashes/unicode)
formats.why: D25: the stored uniqueness key of v_idempotency_keys and the request hash

formats.format: receipt kind drive.node-snapshot, version 1: JSON of every NodeSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP; file/document/viewer heads or null)
formats.why: D25: the stored receipt of folders.create and nodes.rename, decoded on a replay

formats.format: X-Vaulter-Destination-If-Match request header of a move: the strong ETag of the destination folder as the caller reads it (the drive root for a null destination); a mismatch answers 412 node_sequence_mismatch and the folder sequence is checked again under the tree lock; part of the move fingerprint
formats.why: D47 (CC3): the optional precondition of a move on its destination

formats.format: receipt kind drive.purge-receipt, version 1: JSON {kind: node|revision|trash, id, drive_id, scope_node_id, ability, count}; ids and the authorization scope only, never content
formats.why: D25 (ID2): the stored receipt of nodes.purge, files.delete_revision and trash.empty; a replay checks the recorded ability in the recorded scope

formats.format: receipt kind drive.revision-snapshot, version 1: JSON of every FileRevisionSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP)
formats.why: D25: the stored receipt of files.restore_revision, decoded on a replay

formats.format: receipt kind drive.upload-session, version 1: JSON {id, upload_id, drive_id, protocol, status, received_bytes, total_size_bytes, chunk_size, mime_type, target_node_id, target_parent_id, target_name, expires_at}; no staged bytes, storage key or blob
formats.why: D25: the stored receipt of uploads.initiate, decoded on a replay

formats.format: receipt kind drive.access-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: grant, grant: every GrantSnapshot field (snake_case, subject_type/subject_id; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP)} or {type: revoke, revoke: {kind: grant, id, drive_id, node_id, ability}}
formats.why: D25 (ID2): the stored receipt of drive.access.grant and drive.access.revoke; a revoke replay checks Manage on the recorded node

formats.format: receipt kind drive.share-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: link, link} | {type: minted, link, token: Crypt::encryptString(raw token)} | {type: revoke, revoke: {kind: share, id, drive_id, node_id, ability}}; link = every ShareLinkSnapshot field (snake_case), never the token; the raw token is stored only as ciphertext (APP_KEY)
formats.why: D25, D47(5), ID5: the stored receipt of drive.shares.*; a create/rotate replay returns the same token only to the same scope digest after the current authorization

formats.format: receipt kind drive.drive-snapshot, version 1: JSON {id, owner_type, owner_id, profile, name, status, tenant_id, created_at, version}
formats.why: D25, D47(6): the stored receipt of drive.drives.archive, drive.drives.unarchive and drive.drives.delete

formats.format: receipt kind vaulter.problem, version 1: JSON {code, status, details} of a refusal whose code is receipt: cacheable; headers in receipt_headers
formats.why: D25: the stored receipt of a deterministic refusal

formats.format: receipt kind documents.document-snapshot, version 1: JSON {node_id, document_id, type, schema_version, collab_protocol, collab_state_format, type_available, editable, epoch, state_version, dirty, head_revision_id, content: the JSON payload of the content (read back with ContentDecoder::read), revision: receipt-document-revision fields | null, content_hash, collab_state_size, updated_at (Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP), updated_by}
formats.why: D25, D47: the stored receipt of documents.documents.update and .restore

formats.format: receipt kind documents.revision-snapshot, version 1: JSON of every DocumentRevisionSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP); no content
formats.why: D25, D47: the stored receipt of documents.documents.snapshot

formats.format: receipt kind documents.comment-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: comment, comment: every CommentSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP; version)} | {type: deleted, deleted: {id, node_id, drive_id, by_author}}; a deletion keeps the basis of the right (author or Manage), never the comment
formats.why: D25, D47, ID2: the stored receipt of documents.comments.*; a delete replay is authorized by the recorded basis (scope kind node | node-author) now

formats.format: receipt kind webhooks.endpoint-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: endpoint, endpoint: every WebhookEndpointSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP; version; no secret)} | {type: minted, endpoint: as above, secret: Crypt::encryptString ciphertext of the signing secret} | {type: deleted, deleted: {id, tenant_id, ability}} | {type: redelivered, redelivered: {id, endpoint_id}}; a deletion keeps the id and the scope the right was proven in, never the endpoint; a redelivery keeps the ids of the delivery and its endpoint, never the payload
formats.why: D25, D47, ID2, ID5: the stored receipt of webhooks.endpoints.register, update, deactivate, rotate_secret, delete and redeliver; a replay is authorized by the manage ability now, on the recorded scope (the tenant) when the endpoint is gone

formats.format: 201 no-store data envelope: protocol, version, endpoint string|null, opaque token, expires_at Unix seconds, mode read|write, node_id, generation, schema_version, options object<string,string|integer|boolean|null>. Session issued metric vaulter_collab_session_issued_total is documents-owned with protocol and ability labels.
formats.why: PLAN4-D5 P3.3 neutral session wire and public ownership; provider-specific options do not enter the public client API.

formats.format: Operation collaboration.sessions.create uses documents.collaboration_session aggregate with Natural concurrency and Natural idempotency; route documents.collaboration.session.
formats.why: PLAN4-D38: aggregate changes from historical collaboration.session to documents.collaboration_session to match the declaring module; operation key, route and wire remain stable.

formats.format: base64url without padding of HMAC-SHA256(sync_subkey, nine length-prefixed fields: domain, format 2, generation, tagged tenant, drive, actor type, actor id, system reason, node id); sync_subkey = HMAC-SHA256(app.key exact bytes, lp(vaulter.changes.sync_key)||lp(generation)); lp = uint32 big-endian byte length || bytes; 43 chars; anonymous has no key
formats.why: PLAN4-D20: reader-specific remove identity without raw hidden node ids

formats.format: Change = upsert {operation:upsert,sync_key:string|null,node_id,subtree,node_sequence,node} | remove {operation:remove,sync_key:string}; remove has exactly two fields, no raw node id/reason/node/subtree/sequence; anonymous upsert key null and anonymous removes omitted
formats.why: PLAN4-D20 U2: disjoint pre-1.0 OpenAPI/PHP/TS projection; current authorization and reader key, neutral receipts
